items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 114:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the essence of the upper one? Essence means Hochma, and the essence of the upper one indicates the Mocha Stima'ah, which was sealed in a membrane, not to be opened. And what the Mocha Stima'ah bestows below is from the aspect of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, which it receives from the brain of the air, where the Daat of the Reisha de Lo It Yeda is clothed, and not from the aspect of its actual essence. (Item 95).
